title: HR Administrator
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an organised and proactive HR Administrator to join a growing international consultancy on a permanent basis. Supporting the UK and Ireland business, this role will play a key part in the day-to-day delivery of HR operations, ensuring a smooth and professional employee experience across the full employee lifecycle.

This is an excellent opportunity for an HR professional looking to broaden their experience within a fast-paced and collaborative environment. The role offers a varied remit, combining employee relations, recruitment coordination, onboarding, payroll administration and HR process improvement, whilst working closely with senior stakeholders and the wider HR team.

Job Title: HR Administrator

Job Type: Permanent

Location: Farnborough (Hybrid, 2-3 days in the office)

Salary: £35,000

Benefits: Hybrid working, pension, professional development opportunities and employee wellbeing initiatives

Reference No: 16198

HR Administrator About the Role

Reporting to the Head of UK & Ireland, and the Group HR team, you will be responsible for supporting the delivery of HR operations across the UK and Ireland. Acting as a first point of contact for employees and managers, you will provide guidance on HR policies and processes, support recruitment and onboarding activities, maintain employee records and ensure HR administration is managed accurately and efficiently.

The successful candidate will work closely with managers, finance, external HR partners and the wider HR function to ensure employee lifecycle activities are delivered to a high standard. This role requires excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities while handling sensitive information with professionalism and discretion. Main Responsibilities:
- Support the delivery of HR operations across the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, employee changes and offboarding.
- Act as a first point of contact for employees and managers, providing guidance on HR policies, procedures and day-to-day HR queries.
- Coordinate recruitment activities, including vacancy management, candidate screening, interview scheduling and offer administration.
- Support onboarding and induction processes to ensure a positive new starter experience.
- Assist managers with absence management processes and maintain accurate employee records.
- Coordinate probation reviews, performance development reviews and personal development plans.
- Ensure employee information is maintained accurately across HR systems and databases.
- Prepare and manage HR documentation including contracts, letters and employee correspondence.
- Coordinate monthly payroll changes and liaise with payroll providers to ensure accurate processing.
- Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes, systems and policies.
- Build positive working relationships with employees, managers and external stakeholders.
- Maintain confidentiality and ensure compliance with data protection requirements and employment legislation.

The Successful Candidate Will Have:
- Previous experience within an HR Administration, HR Coordinator, HR Officer or similar HR role.
- A good understanding of the employee lifecycle and core HR processes.
- Experience supporting recruitment, onboarding and employee administration activities.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when handling employee data and documentation.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to liaise with stakeholders at all levels.
- The ability to exercise sound judgement and identify when matters require escalation.
- Experience coordinating payroll information would be advantageous.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification, or working towards CIPD accreditation, would be desirable.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office and HR systems.
- A professional, collaborative and customer-focused approach.

- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client records and accounting systems
- Organising and managing own workload effectively to ensure deadlines are achieved and client expectations are met
- Supporting Managers and Partners with administrative and accounting assignments as required
- Undertaking ad hoc projects and assignments as requested by the Partners

We welcome application from candidates with the following skills and experience:
- Ideally be AAT qualified, although this is not essential
- Applicants will have experience gained within a UK accountancy firm
- Solid bookkeeping, management accounting and VAT experience
- Be organised, able to prioritise workloads and manage time effectively
- Have good general IT skills - a working knowledge of MS Office - and some familiarity with accounting software such as Xero, Sage, QuickBooks or IRIS
- Be focused on providing high-quality work for clients
- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills
